text:
Aisha (Partnerships): Quick scrub: marketplace launch readiness — press + partner assets. 48h check. Please confirm owners and blockers.
Tom (PM): Thanks — listing + pricing mapping done. Need confirm on hero image and embargo window from marketing.
Lina (Marketing): Hero image still WIP (localization for FR/DE). Can we ship EN hero at launch and swap later?
Aisha (Partnerships): Prefer single hero at go-live to avoid layout drift. Marta, any legal flags on using partner logos in the hero?
Marta (Legal): Partner logos approved except AcmeHW — need their signed brand kit by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi (Eng): SI integration smoke tests green for core flows. One item: tenant provisioning script 2/3 fails on region eu-west-1 intermittently. Investigating.
Jordan (Platform): Noted — autoscaler config for dedicated listings needs a small tweak (burst capacity limit). I can push a safe change tonight.
Tom (PM): Lina — press embargo window still 9am PT on Tue? Confirm so we can line up blog publish + social.
Lina (Marketing): Yes, 9am PT Tue. Press release drafted; need final quote from CEO and partner comms approval.
Aisha (Partnerships): Partner comms: have we queued the partner announcement emails? Who owns the partner-facing landing copy?
Tom (PM): I can own partner landing copy. Requesting SI section from Ravi for integration notes + getting-started.
Ravi (Eng): Will drop a 200–300 word SI getting-started and code snippet for tenant onboarding. Example snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"name":"acme-tenant","region":"eu-west-1"}'
```
Lina (Marketing): Also need tracking params for partner links. Suggest: `?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudstore_launch`
Jordan (Platform): QA note — confirm redirect chain for partner CTA (marketplace listing -> partner landing -> signup). We should avoid more than one redirect for SEO.
Aisha (Partnerships): Assets matrix: hero image (Lina), logos (partners + Marta sign-off), partner one-pager PDFs (partners), SI guide (Ravi), marketplace listing screenshots (Jordan). Any missing owners?
Tom (PM): I'll own the screenshots and final listing copy.
Marta (Legal): Also need to confirm data-processing blurb on the marketplace listing — I'll approve language by EOD.
PartnerBot: Reminder: embargo checklist due in 36 hours. Link: https://docs.redwood/embargo-checklist
Lina (Marketing): Localization owners: FR (Claire), DE (Sebastian). I'll ping them to prioritize hero variants.
Ravi (Eng): Workaround for tenant provisioning flake: retry logic + circuit-breaker on region ephemeral errors. I'll PR in staging now.
Jordan (Platform): I'll run a preflight tomorrow that validates provisioning end-to-end and the redirect chain. Will post results here.
Aisha (Partnerships): Two ask items before I close this scrub: 1) Confirm legal sign-offs (Marta) 2) Confirm partner logos in place (partners) — if both green, we call ready.
Marta (Legal): Confirmed pending AcmeHW signed kit. If not received by EOD tomorrow we remove their logo from hero and include in partner list only.
Tom (PM): Noted. Contingency: if AcmeHW delays, we publish with alternate hero and include them in the partner page.
Lina (Marketing): One more: tracking for paid ads needs final UTM mapping. I'll share a spreadsheet in #marketing ops.
Aisha (Partnerships): Great. If anyone hits blockers overnight, drop in this thread or ping me. Last-minute checklist: hero, logos, embargo sign-off, SI guide, tenant preflight, redirect chain.
Ravi (Eng): PR submitted for retry logic — CI green. Will monitor staging run.
Jordan (Platform): Preflight scheduled 06:30 PT tomorrow.
Tom (PM): I'll assemble final release playbook with timestamps for blog, PR, partner email and bug-runbook.
Lina (Marketing): I'll queue social and press contact list. Sending final quote slot to CEO now. :thumbsup:
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks team — check back here after preflight. :rocket:
PartnerBot: Deploy bot: release-candidate/marketplace-listing deployed to staging at 5067891300.
Tom (PM): Noted deployment. Jordan — can you validate the deployed listing URL after your preflight?
Jordan (Platform): Will do and report back by 07:15 PT.
Aisha (Partnerships): Closing note: keep messages short in this thread. We'll open a post-launch channel for monitoring.
Lina (Marketing): Understood. Good luck everyone!
Jordan (Platform): Preflight done — redirect chain clean, provision flow flaky on second run but retry handled it. Marking as "green with note".
Ravi (Eng): Logged the intermittent provisioning metric; follow-up ticket created RF-221.
Tom (PM): Playbook draft ready, I'll circulate in 30m.
Marta (Legal): AcmeHW brand kit received — approved. All legal flags cleared.
Aisha (Partnerships): All green. Moving to final go/no-go sync on Monday 08:30 PT. Thanks all.
